description:
Individual text interaction message extracted from LMS discussion forums,
course chats, or reflective learning journals.
Transmitted from LMS to Component 1 (Affective State Detection).
Strictly redacted: raw_text and identifying tokens are prohibited.

clean_text.title: Clean Text

message_id.description: Unique identifier of the communication item within LMS

message_length_chars.description: Character count of the scrubbed message text
message_length_chars.title: Message Length Chars

message_length_words.description: Word count of the scrubbed message text
message_length_words.title: Message Length Words

reply_to_id.description: Message ID this post replies to, if part of a thread
reply_to_id.title: Reply To Id

response_latency_seconds.description: Elapsed seconds before a reply/post was made, if applicable
response_latency_seconds.title: Response Latency Seconds
